entries.title: Genesis 4:1
segments: ¶Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, "I have acquired a man from the LORD."

entries.title: Genesis 4:2
segments: Then she bore again, this time his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 4:3
segments: ¶And in the process of time it came to pass that Cain brought an offering of the fruit of the ground to the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 4:4
segments: Abel also brought of the firstborn of his flock and of their fat. And the LORD respected Abel and his offering,

entries.title: Genesis 4:5
segments: but He did not respect Cain and his offering. And Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.

entries.title: Genesis 4:6
segments: ¶So the LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry? And why has your countenance fallen?

entries.title: Genesis 4:7
segments: "If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin lies at the door. And its desire [is] for you, but you should rule over it."

entries.title: Genesis 4:8
segments: ¶Now Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.

entries.title: Genesis 4:9
segments: ¶Then the LORD said to Cain, "Where [is] Abel your brother?" He said, "I do not know. [Am] I my brother's keeper?"

entries.title: Genesis 4:10
segments: And He said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries out to Me from the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 4:11
segments: "So now you [are] cursed from the earth, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.

entries.title: Genesis 4:12
segments: "When you till the ground, it shall no longer yield its strength to you. A fugitive and a vagabond you shall be on the earth."

entries.title: Genesis 4:13
segments: ¶And Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment [is] greater than I can bear!

entries.title: Genesis 4:14
segments: "Surely You have driven me out this day from the face of the ground; I shall be hidden from Your face; I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond on the earth, and it will happen [that] anyone who finds me will kill me."

entries.title: Genesis 4:15
segments: And the LORD said to him, "Therefore, whoever kills Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold." And the LORD set a mark on Cain, lest anyone finding him should kill him.

entries.title: Genesis 4:16
segments: ¶Then Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and dwelt in the land of Nod on the east of Eden.

entries.title: Genesis 4:17
segments: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch. And he built a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son-Enoch.

entries.title: Genesis 4:18
segments: To Enoch was born Irad; and Irad begot Mehujael, and Mehujael begot Methushael, and Methushael begot Lamech.

entries.title: Genesis 4:19
segments: ¶Then Lamech took for himself two wives: the name of one [was] Adah, and the name of the second [was] Zillah.

entries.title: Genesis 4:20
segments: And Adah bore Jabal. He was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

entries.title: Genesis 4:21
segments: His brother's name [was] Jubal. He was the father of all those who play the harp and flute.

entries.title: Genesis 4:22
segments: And as for Zillah, she also bore Tubal-Cain, an instructor of every craftsman in bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-Cain [was] Naamah.

entries.title: Genesis 4:23
segments: ¶Then Lamech said to his wives: "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Wives of Lamech, listen to my speech! For I have killed a man for wounding me, Even a young man for hurting me.

entries.title: Genesis 4:24
segments: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Then Lamech seventy-sevenfold."

entries.title: Genesis 4:25
segments: ¶And Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, "For God has appointed another seed for me instead of Abel, whom Cain killed."

entries.title: Genesis 4:26
segments: And as for Seth, to him also a son was born; and he named him Enosh. Then [men] began to call on the name of the LORD.
